plan.goal: Expand Pocket Ramanujan to 13 detailed, sourced topics and deploy the complete collection.
success_criteria: All 13 planned discovery pages exist and are statically generated.
Each lesson meets the detailed teaching, examples, source, formula, and attribution standard.
Discovery order and previous/next navigation follow one stable manifest.
All unit, content, browser, link, and build checks pass.
The complete site is deployed at the current canonical Vercel URL and all changes are pushed to GitHub.
plan.deliverable: Ten additional detailed lessons, consistent navigation, verified production deployment, and committed/pushed changes.

risks.mitigation: Compare original and scholarly historical sources; label independent discovery and later proofs carefully.

risks.risk: Mock theta functions are easy to overstate using modern definitions retroactively.
risks.mitigation: Separate Ramanujan's original language from posthumous theory and cite both periods.

risks.risk: The Master Theorem requires hypotheses not suitable for an unqualified beginner statement.
risks.mitigation: State an illustrative special case and cite the general theorem's analytic assumptions.

risks.risk: Regularized divergent sums may be mistaken for ordinary convergent sums.
risks.mitigation: Make the summation method explicit and directly contrast regularized assignment with partial-sum convergence.

risks.risk: Production deployment or canonical metadata can diverge from the deployed domain.
risks.mitigation: Smoke-test canonical links, robots, sitemap, public routes, and remote Git head after deploy.
